notes: Historical T512 is included by explicit path and excluded from new-run/update totals.
Only completed passed ordinary full-model capacity reports enter figures; correctness and numerical screens never enter timing curves.
Retention is saved-receipt verification plus local archive hashes, not a new cloud request.
Missing pending retention does not invalidate a passed measurement; source/dependency integrity failures do.
Memory free samples are not continuous minima; setup reservation includes cache and steady allocation omits graph-pool reservation.
Long contexts have more attention work per input token. Equal tokens/update is a systems comparison, not equal model quality or equal optimization.
